summary: Iteration-8 full-stack test of 'Verse Text Size' feature (admin-nudgeable verse size, 1..10, default 5). Backend: PUT /api/appearance/bible accepts verse_size 1/5/10 (persists via GET), rejects 0/11/-1/100 with HTTP 422; GET defaults contain verse_size=5 for both /bible and /register; mutating verse_size leaves reference_size/accent_color/text_color/muted_color/background_color/panel_color unchanged. 10/10 pytest tests pass. Frontend: /settings-admin PIN gate 1234 unlocks; Bible tab shows reference-panel titled 'Scripture text & reference' containing verse-size-slider (default value 5, with helper copy about long verses) plus the existing color-reference and reference-size controls; register tab has no reference-panel (unchanged). Preview iframe (sample content ON) reflects slider instantly: at verse_size=5 bible-verse-text font-size=71.3px, at verse_size=10 it grows to 99.8px, at verse_size=1 it shrinks to 48.5px; bible-reference font-size stays 43.2px across all three settings (reference styling decoupled). Dirty indicator switches to 'Unsaved changes (preview only)'. Fit-safety verified by publishing a real passage to /bible with verse_size=10: (a) short verse John 11:35 renders at ~121px in both 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 and remains inside the viewport; (b) long verse Esther 8:9 (543 chars) auto-shrinks via FitText to 59.0px (portrait) / 54.8px (landscape) and fully fits inside both viewports with the reference above the verse. Short-verse font-size is >2x the long-verse size at the same verse_size=10, confirming per-verse auto-fit still works. Snapshotted & fully restored: bible appearance restored to verse_size=5 / reference_size=5 / accent=#F59E0B; /bible display cleared back to idle; user's church_name 'Providence Baptist Church', logo, and bible background image preserved untouched; no DELETE on images/logo and no church-name mutation.
critical_code_review_comments: appearance.py — verse_size added as int field with ge=1/le=10 default 5; validation returns 422 for out-of-range values. Clean, mirrors reference_size.

ReferencePanel.jsx — verse-size slider renders above reference color/size with helpful copy ('Larger helps screens viewed from far away. Very long verses still shrink to fit the screen.'). Panel title correctly renamed to 'Scripture text & reference'. Good UX.

BibleDisplay.jsx FitText — scale prop = 0.6 + verse_size*0.08 maps 1..10 -> 0.68..1.40 of the length-derived base size, then the group-measure loop shrinks (0.93x per step) when the group overflows. Esther 8:9 at verse_size=10 shrinks from ~1.40x base down to 59px to fit 1080x1920 while John 11:35 keeps the full 121px — correct behaviour.
AppearanceEditor.jsx KEYS array includes verse_size so it is sent on PUT. verse_size is also present in COLOR_LABELS-free RangeField flow (correctly outside Colors panel).
seed_data_creation: Transient only: published Esther 8:9 and John 11:35 manual-source passages via /api/bible/publish while verse_size=10 for fit-safety measurement at 1080x1920 and 1920x1080. At end, verse_size restored to 5 and /bible display cleared to idle. User's church_name/logo/background image untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: User state restored: verse_size=5, reference_size=5, accent_color=#F59E0B, church_name='Providence Baptist Church', logo + bible background image intact. Verse-size testids: verse-size-slider, verse-size-value, verse-size-field. The shadcn Slider testid is on the wrapper (not an <input>) — drive it via its [role='slider'] thumb child using keyboard: focus the thumb, press Home then ArrowRight N-1 times to set value N (for min=1 max=10). Preview iframe DOM is accessed via element_handle.content_frame() on [data-testid='display-preview-frame']. Allow ~1.5-2s after changing verse_size so FitText's measure/shrink loop can run.
